name: klaviyo-shopify-preferences
description: Shopify embedded app that lets customers manage their Klaviyo marketing preferences via a Cloudflare Worker proxy
summary: Lets customers update their email marketing preferences like categories and interests directly on the Shopify store, syncing those choices with Klaviyo for targeted marketing. Store managers use it to keep customer preferences accurate without manual updates, improving personalized communication. It handles secure data transfer behind the scenes, so customers control what emails they receive without extra hassle for staff.
